questions.title: Loop Control
questions.description: In Java, which loop is guaranteed to execute its body at least once, even if the condition is initially false?
questions.explanation: A do-while loop checks its condition after executing the block, guaranteeing at least one execution.

questions.title: Array Bounds
questions.description: If an array is declared as `int[] arr = new int[5];`, what happens if you try to access `arr[5]`?
questions.explanation: Array indices are zero-based. A size of 5 means valid indices are 0 through 4. Accessing index 5 throws an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

options.text: The array automatically expands to size 6.

questions.title: Find the Maximum
questions.description: Read an integer N, followed by N integers. Print the largest number in the list.
questions.inputFormat:
Line 1: Integer N
Line 2: N space-separated integers
questions.outputFormat: A single integer representing the maximum value.

questions.title: Fibonacci Sequence
questions.description:
Write a program that prints the first N numbers of the Fibonacci sequence separated by spaces.
The sequence starts with 0 and 1.
